name: isogram
tagline: Diagrams that build the thing they explain.
about:
isogram is a Claude skill for animated isometric diagrams that explain how a feature works. You describe the feature; Claude invents a small machine whose motion is the explanation, and hands it back as a web component, a GIF, a PNG or an SVG.

The mark is the smallest isometric thing there is: one cube on drafting paper, its top face in the cobalt that marks whatever is live, its sides in the two inks of the page.
construction: On a 256 grid: three faces of one cube, the top vertex at (128, 24) and the foot at (128, 240), each face rising 56 for every 96 across; the one-colour version cuts the inner Y out 14 wide.
